title: Warm Blackberry Tarte Tatin
description: A twist on the classic French dessert, this warm blackberry tarte tatin is perfect for a cold evening. The combination of caramelized blackberries and flaky pastry is sure to impress.
instructions: Roll out puff pastry and place in a 9-inch tart pan.
In a bowl, mix together blackberries, sugar, and vanilla extract.
Arrange the blackberry mixture in the center of the pastry, leaving a 1-inch border.
Dot the top of the blackberries with butter.
Fold the edges of the pastry up over the blackberries, pressing gently to seal.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and the blackberries are tender.
Remove from oven and let cool for 5 minutes.
Invert onto a plate and serve warm.
